label: Formulated the definitive doctrine of tripartite separation of executive, legislative, and judicial powers
Provided the comparative framework of civic liberty and political regimes analyzed in The Social Contract
Informed Kant's republican political philosophy and legal doctrine of tripartite state authority
Inspired Hegel's conception of the 'spirit' (Geist) of laws and ethical life (Sittlichkeit) embodied in institutions
Montesquieu's sociological analysis of commerce (doux commerce) and legal institutions influenced Smith's political economy and stages of society
